note: The provenance over-inclusion AUDIT LEDGER (docs/GAPS.md §16). One entry per shipped catalog row that is absent from the open-content source it cites, keyed '<systemId>/<category>|<normalized name>'. `class` is from the closed vocabulary in scripts/check-provenance-over-inclusion.mjs; `evidence` must state what was actually compared. `taggedSource` pins the entry's CURRENT source attribution so that silently editing the tag to make the finding disappear fails the gate. Regenerate the skeleton with `npm run srd:overinclusion:record` (preserves existing class/evidence), then classify by hand — the classification is the audit, and it is not machine-derivable.

classes.naming-variant: Same entry as the source, under a different name; the source-named entry does NOT also ship.
classes.duplicate-alias: The loader ALSO ships this entry under its correct source name — a duplicated catalog row, not a missing name.
classes.generic-entry-instantiation: The source ships a generic rule/table row; the product ships pre-built instances of it.
classes.category-rollup: The shipped entry is a source TABLE or CATEGORY header, not an individual source entry (cf. GAPS §11 OC-2).
classes.denominator-scope-defect: The entry IS in the cited source, but the coverage script fetches an incomplete slice of that source.
classes.denominator-shape-artifact: The source and the product disagree about entry GRANULARITY (combined table vs per-variant rows), so the diff double-counts.
classes.wrong-edition-attribution: LICENSING-ADJACENT. Real open content, but from a different edition/source than the entry’s source tag claims.
classes.genuine-non-open-content: LICENSING. No counterpart in any cited open-content source, under any name.
classes.upstream-defect: The entry is in the source, but the source itself is malformed or mis-shaped.
classes.undetermined: Could not be established. Must state why in the evidence field.

pf2e/spells|firestorm.name: Firestorm
pf2e/spells|firestorm.evidence: PF1e/3.5 SRD 'Fire Storm' (PSRD book-cr.db section 226: druid 7 / cleric 8, 1d6 fire per caster level, Reflex save); shipped record is level 7 divine+primal cleric/druid with a Reflex save and an area given as 'five 10-foot cubes' - the N-10-foot-cubes area idiom is 3.5/PF1e Fire Storm's, and no Pf2eTools file contains any spell named Firestorm or Fire Storm.

pf2e/spells|forcecage.name: Forcecage
pf2e/spells|forcecage.evidence: PF1e/3.5 SRD spell (PSRD book-cr.db section 238: sorcerer 7 / wizard 7, 'Cube or cage of force imprisons all inside', 'immobile, invisible cubical prison ... of force'); shipped record is level 7 arcane sorcerer/wizard, 'invisible, immobile, cube-shaped prison of magical force' - not present in any Pf2eTools PF2e file, yet tagged 'Core Rulebook'.

pf2e/spells|geyser.name: Geyser
pf2e/spells|geyser.evidence: Not in spells-crb.json under any name; the only PF2e Geyser is spells/spells-som.json (Secrets of Magic, level 5, 3d6 bludgeoning + 4d6 fire), while the shipped record (level 6, 7d12 fire, arcane+primal, druid/sorcerer/wizard, 'geyser of boiling water') tracks PF1e APG Geyser (PSRD book-apg.db section 131, 'Creates a geyser of boiling water', druid 4 / sorcerer 5 / wizard 5) - either way the 'Core Rulebook' source tag is wrong.
